```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidymodels)
library(xgboost)
library(themis) # for upsampling
library(doParallel) # for parallel processing
library(caret) # for classification metrics
library(vip) # for variable importance plots

tidymodels_prefer()
```

```{r}
random_seed <- 8

raw <- read.csv("mergedData_2023.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
glimpse(raw)
```

# Data Setup
```{r}
dat <- raw |>
  select(-STATE, -CZ_NAME, -MONTH_NAME)

# ------------- handling missing data -------------

# replace NA damage with the median for that county and event type
dat <- dat |>
  group_by(FIPS, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  mutate(DAMAGE_PROPERTY = if_else(is.na(DAMAGE_PROPERTY), median(DAMAGE_PROPERTY, na.rm = TRUE),DAMAGE_PROPERTY)) |>
  ungroup()

# if still NA, just replace with overall median (e.g., for FIPS/event type combos with all NA damage) for that event type
dat <- dat |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE) |>
  mutate(DAMAGE_PROPERTY = if_else(is.na(DAMAGE_PROPERTY), median(DAMAGE_PROPERTY, na.rm = TRUE), DAMAGE_PROPERTY))

# drop the rest of the na values
dat <- dat |>
  drop_na()

# ------------- handling skewed data -------------
dat <- dat |>
  # log-transform damage, duration, area, and population as they are highly skewed
  mutate(DAMAGE_PROPERTY = log1p(DAMAGE_PROPERTY)) |>
  mutate(DURATION_MINUTES = log1p(DURATION_MINUTES)) |>
  mutate(STORM_AREA_SQMILES = log1p(STORM_AREA_SQMILES)) |>
  mutate(POPULATION = log1p(POPULATION))

# ------------- feature engineering -------------
dat <- dat |>
  # merging Lightning into Thunderstorm Wind — too few samples and indistinguishable
  mutate(
    EVENT_TYPE = if_else(EVENT_TYPE == "Lightning", "Thunderstorm Wind", EVENT_TYPE),
    EVENT_TYPE = factor(EVENT_TYPE) 
    ) |>
  
  # binary zero indicators — flag whether measurement was zero
  mutate(
    DAMAGE_ZERO = as.integer(DAMAGE_PROPERTY == 0),
    AREA_ZERO = as.integer(STORM_AREA_SQMILES == 0), 
    DURATION_ZERO = as.integer(DURATION_MINUTES == 0)
    ) |>
  
  # cyclical encoding for month — lets model understand the proximity of the months
  mutate(
    MONTH_SIN = sin(2 * pi * MONTH / 12),
    MONTH_COS = cos(2 * pi * MONTH / 12),
    COASTAL_TYPE_SHORELINE = if_else(COASTAL_TYPE_SHORELINE == "inland", 0, 1 ),
    COASTAL_TYPE_WATERSHED = if_else(COASTAL_TYPE_WATERSHED == "inland", 0, 1 ),
    MODAL_YEAR_BUILT_BIN = as.numeric(factor(MODAL_YEAR_BUILT_BIN))
  ) |>
  
  # engineered features — density proxies
  mutate(
    DAMAGE_DENSITY =
      if_else(STORM_AREA_SQMILES > 0, DAMAGE_PROPERTY / STORM_AREA_SQMILES, 0),
    DURATION_DENSITY =
      if_else(STORM_AREA_SQMILES > 0 , DURATION_MINUTES / STORM_AREA_SQMILES, 0)
  ) |>
  
  # climate-geography interactions — regional climate patterns differ by latitude
  mutate(
    LAT_X_TEMP = BEGIN_LAT * TEMPERATURE_F,
    LAT_X_ANOMALY = BEGIN_LAT * ANOMALY_F
  ) |>

  # to help weed out the difference between thunderstorm wind and hail events, the main difference is that hail events tend to be shorter and smaller.
  mutate(
    DURATION_X_AREA = DURATION_MINUTES * STORM_AREA_SQMILES,,
  ) |>
  
  select(-FIPS, -MONTH)

glimpse(dat)
```

# Machine Learning pipeline

```{r}
split      <- initial_split(dat, prop = 0.75, strata = EVENT_TYPE)
train_data <- training(split)
test_data  <- testing(split)
```

### Preprocessing

```{r}

recipe_smote <- recipe(EVENT_TYPE ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.numeric)) |>
  step_smote(EVENT_TYPE, over_ratio = 0.3, seed = random_seed, neighbors = 5)
 
```

### Model Specification

```{r}
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees          = tune(),
  tree_depth     = tune(),
  learn_rate     = tune(),
  min_n          = tune(),
  mtry           = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("xgboost") |>
  set_mode("classification")
 
wf_smote <- workflow() |> add_recipe(recipe_smote)  |> add_model(xgb_spec)
```

### Tunning

```{r}
xgb_grid <- grid_space_filling(
  trees(range = c(300, 1500)),
  tree_depth(range = c(4, 10)),
  learn_rate(range = c(-3, -1)),
  min_n(range = c(5, 40)),
  mtry(range = c(5, 15)),
  loss_reduction(range = c(-2, 1)),
  size = 80
)

cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5, strata = EVENT_TYPE)
macro_f1 <- metric_set(f_meas)

ctrl <- control_grid(
  verbose       = TRUE,
  save_pred     = FALSE,
  allow_par     = TRUE,
  parallel_over = "everything"
)

```

```{r, cache = TRUE}

n_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE) - 2
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(n_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

tune_smote <- tune_grid(
  wf_smote,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  grid      = xgb_grid,
  metrics   = macro_f1,
  control   = ctrl
)

stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()
```

```{r}
autoplot(tune_smote) + ggtitle("SMOTE Tuning Results")

best_smote <- show_best(tune_smote, metric = "f_meas", n = 1)

best_smote
```

```{r, cache = TRUE}
params_smote  <- select_best(tune_smote, metric = "f_meas")
 
final_smote <- finalize_workflow(wf_smote, params_smote) |> fit(data = train_data)
```

```{r}
final_smote |>
  extract_fit_parsnip() |>
  vip(num_features = 15)
```

### Evaluation

```{r}
evaluate_model <- function(fitted_wf, train_data, test_data, label) {
  # --- Training set ---
  train_preds <- predict(fitted_wf, train_data) |>
    bind_cols(train_data |> select(EVENT_TYPE))
  train_cm <- confusionMatrix(train_preds$.pred_class, train_data$EVENT_TYPE)
 
  # --- Test set ---
  test_preds <- predict(fitted_wf, test_data) |>
    bind_cols(test_data |> select(EVENT_TYPE))
  test_cm <- confusionMatrix(test_preds$.pred_class, test_data$EVENT_TYPE)
 
  cat("\n===", label, "===\n")
 
  # Training balanced accuracy (mean of per-class recall)
  train_bal_acc <- mean(train_cm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"])
  cat("\n--- Training Balanced Accuracy:", round(train_bal_acc, 4), "---\n")
  
  test_bal_smote  <- mean(results_smote$test$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"])
  cat("\n--- Test Balanced Accuracy:", round(test_bal_smote, 4), "---\n")
 
  cat("\n--- Test Confusion Matrix ---\n")
  print(test_cm$table)
 
  cat("\n--- Test Overall Metrics ---\n")
  print(test_cm$overall)
 
  cat("\n--- Test Per-Class Metrics ---\n")
  print(test_cm$byClass)
 
  # Return both for comparison
  invisible(list(train = train_cm, test = test_cm))
}
```

```{r}
results_smote <- evaluate_model(final_smote,    train_data, test_data, "SMOTE")
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# 1. CLASSIFY AND BIN
# =============================================================================
 
dat$pred <- predict(final_smote, dat)$.pred_class
 
# 0.5° grid cells
dat$LAT_BIN <- round(dat$BEGIN_LAT * 2) / 2
dat$LON_BIN <- round(dat$BEGIN_LON * 2) / 2
 
# --- Historical: aggregate actual labels ---
grid_historical <- dat |>
  group_by(LAT_BIN, LON_BIN) |>
  summarize(
    dominant_type = names(which.max(table(EVENT_TYPE))),
    n_events      = n(),
    concentration = max(table(EVENT_TYPE)) / n(),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_events >= 5)
 
# --- Predicted: aggregate model classifications ---
grid_predicted <- dat |>
  group_by(LAT_BIN, LON_BIN) |>
  summarize(
    dominant_type = names(which.max(table(pred))),
    n_events      = n(),
    concentration = max(table(pred)) / n(),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_events >= 5)
 
cat("Historical grid cells:", nrow(grid_historical), "\n")
cat("Predicted grid cells: ", nrow(grid_predicted), "\n\n")
 
cat("Historical dominant type distribution:\n")
print(table(grid_historical$dominant_type))
cat("\nPredicted dominant type distribution:\n")
print(table(grid_predicted$dominant_type))
cat("\n")
 
# =============================================================================
# 2. AGREEMENT SUMMARY
# =============================================================================
# How often do the historical and predicted maps agree on dominant type?
 
agreement <- inner_join(
  grid_historical |> select(LAT_BIN, LON_BIN, hist_type = dominant_type),
  grid_predicted  |> select(LAT_BIN, LON_BIN, pred_type = dominant_type),
  by = c("LAT_BIN", "LON_BIN")
)
 
agree_pct <- mean(agreement$hist_type == agreement$pred_type) * 100
cat(sprintf("Agreement between maps: %.1f%% of cells\n\n", agree_pct))
 
# =============================================================================
# 3. SHARED PLOT ELEMENTS
# =============================================================================
 
us_states <- map_data("state")
 
storm_colors <- c(
  "Flash Flood"       = "#1B9E77",
  "Flood"             = "#2166AC",
  "Hail"              = "#E6AB02",
  "Heavy Rain"        = "#7570B3",
  "Thunderstorm Wind" = "#E7298A",
  "Tornado"           = "#D95F02"
)
 
# Shared theme for consistent styling
map_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
 
# =============================================================================
# 4. HISTORICAL MAP
# =============================================================================
 
p_hist <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = grid_historical,
    aes(x = LON_BIN, y = LAT_BIN, fill = dominant_type),
    alpha = 0.85,
    width = 0.5,
    height = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = us_states,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = NA,
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = storm_colors,
    name   = "Dominant storm type"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-125, -66.5), ylim = c(24.5, 49.5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Historical (actual NOAA labels)",
    subtitle = "Dominant recorded event type per cell (0.5° grid, n >= 5)",
    x        = "Longitude",
    y        = "Latitude"
  ) +
  map_theme
 
# =============================================================================
# 5. PREDICTED MAP
# =============================================================================
 
p_pred <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = grid_predicted,
    aes(x = LON_BIN, y = LAT_BIN, fill = dominant_type),
    alpha = 0.85,
    width = 0.5,
    height = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = us_states,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = NA,
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = storm_colors,
    name   = "Dominant storm type"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-125, -66.5), ylim = c(24.5, 49.5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Predicted (model classifications)",
    subtitle = "Dominant classified event type per cell (0.5° grid, n >= 5)",
    x        = "Longitude",
    y        = "Latitude"
  ) +
  map_theme
 
# =============================================================================
# 6. COMBINED OUTPUT
# =============================================================================
# Stack vertically with a shared legend
 
combined <- p_hist / p_pred +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Historical vs predicted storm risk profiles",
    subtitle = sprintf("Cell-level agreement: %.1f%%", agree_pct),
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 11)
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
 
ggsave(
  "risk_profile_comparison.png",
  plot   = combined,
  width  = 14,
  height = 16,
  dpi    = 300
)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 1. SELECT A SAMPLE CELL
# =============================================================================
# Pick a cell with moderate event count — enough to have a historical
# distribution but sparse enough that some storm types are missing.
# This makes the comparison more interesting.
 
dat$LAT_BIN <- round(dat$BEGIN_LAT * 2) / 2
dat$LON_BIN <- round(dat$BEGIN_LON * 2) / 2
 
cell_candidates <- dat |>
  group_by(LAT_BIN, LON_BIN) |>
  summarize(
    n_events = n(),
    n_types  = length(unique(EVENT_TYPE)),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Cells with 15–60 events and fewer than all 6 types
  filter(n_events >= 15, n_events <= 60, n_types < 6) |>
  arrange(n_types, desc(n_events))
 
sample_cell <- cell_candidates |> slice(4)
 
cat("Sample cell: lat =", sample_cell$LAT_BIN,
    ", lon =", sample_cell$LON_BIN, "\n")
cat("Events:", sample_cell$n_events,
    "| Recorded types:", sample_cell$n_types, "\n\n")
 
cell_data <- dat |>
  filter(LAT_BIN == sample_cell$LAT_BIN, LON_BIN == sample_cell$LON_BIN)
 
# =============================================================================
# 2. HISTORICAL PROPORTIONS
# =============================================================================
# Simple count of actual event types in this cell
 
all_types <- levels(dat$EVENT_TYPE)
 
hist_counts <- table(factor(cell_data$EVENT_TYPE, levels = all_types))
hist_props  <- prop.table(hist_counts)
 
historical <- data.frame(
  storm_type  = names(hist_props),
  proportion  = as.numeric(hist_props),
  source      = "Historical"
)
 
cat("Historical proportions:\n")
print(hist_props)
cat("\n")
 
# =============================================================================
# 3. PREDICTED PROPORTIONS
# =============================================================================
# Average predicted class probabilities across all events in the cell.
# The model assigns non-zero probability to storm types even if they
# never occurred locally — borrowing signal from similar communities.
 
pred_probs <- predict(final_smote, cell_data, type = "prob")
 
avg_probs <- colMeans(pred_probs)
names(avg_probs) <- gsub("^\\.pred_", "", names(avg_probs))
 
predicted <- data.frame(
  storm_type  = names(avg_probs),
  proportion  = as.numeric(avg_probs),
  source      = "Predicted"
)
 
cat("Predicted proportions:\n")
print(round(avg_probs, 4))
cat("\n")
 
# Flag types that are absent historically but predicted
absent_types <- historical$storm_type[historical$proportion == 0]
predicted_absent <- predicted |>
  filter(storm_type %in% absent_types, proportion > 0.01)
if (nrow(predicted_absent) > 0) {
  cat("Storm types absent from history but predicted by model:\n")
  print(predicted_absent)
  cat("\n")
}
 
# =============================================================================
# 4. PLOT
# =============================================================================
 
plot_data <- bind_rows(historical, predicted)
plot_data$source <- factor(plot_data$source, levels = c("Historical", "Predicted"))
 
storm_colors <- c(
  "Flash Flood"       = "#1B9E77",
  "Flood"             = "#2166AC",
  "Hail"              = "#E6AB02",
  "Heavy Rain"        = "#7570B3",
  "Thunderstorm Wind" = "#E7298A",
  "Tornado"           = "#D95F02"
)
 
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = storm_type, y = proportion, fill = storm_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = storm_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf(
      "Historical vs predicted storm proportions (%.1f\u00b0N, %.1f\u00b0W)",
      sample_cell$LAT_BIN, abs(sample_cell$LON_BIN)
    ),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "%d events in cell | %d of 6 storm types recorded historically",
      sample_cell$n_events, sample_cell$n_types
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
 
print(p)
 
ggsave(
  "historical_vs_predicted.png",
  plot   = p,
  width  = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi    = 300
)
cat("Saved: historical_vs_predicted.png\n")
```
